scores.claim_text: HII teams with General Dynamics/Electric Boat on Virginia and Columbia class submarines.
scores.M_check: Mode A: General Dynamics is a real entity with confirmed extensive USAspending presence and is itself a top DoD prime — partnership realism not in doubt. Mode B: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Huntington Ingalls', cik=0000040533 GD) returned 0 hits; edgar_fts(search_term='Newport News Shipbuilding', cik=0000040533) returned 0 hits. Conversely HII's own filings reference Electric Boat 43 times.
scores.M_value: GD 10-K disclosures contain zero name-matches for HII/Newport News; HII discloses Electric Boat 43x
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic 7, the asymmetric counterparty disclosure (HII names GD/Electric Boat; GD does not name HII) would normally be a SEVE, but this is a well-known industry teaming structure where each is alternately prime/sub. GD's Columbia/Virginia disclosures speak about Electric Boat as the prime and don't itemize sub-tier teaming partners. Sub-tier disclosure-threshold caveat (heuristic 7c) applies: HII revenue from the GD teaming arrangement is not the same as a sales-into-counterparty pattern. Net: MODERATE — partnership realism solid but cross-disclosure absent.
